Volume: 201x201x157 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text: Segmentation complete. Final mask v9 (255.8 mL) covers the homogeneous T1-hyperintense encapsulated anterolateral soft-tissue mass, well separated from humeral marrow. Inferior leak removed with paint-erase; final review showed no lesion beyond mask extents and candidates were normal fat/marrow.
